name_reason: Already conforms to convention: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with battle-core prefix data_fd2_battle_, and the descriptor 'spell_effect_table' correctly reflects both the content (per-spell stat/effect data) and the data type (a table/array). No Ghidra address residue in the name. The element-id range (spell ids 0x00..0x23) is the table dimension, not encoded in the symbol name. No rename needed.
purpose: Read-only master table of per-spell stat/effect data, one fixed-size entry per spell id 0x00..0x23 (36 spells); consumed by combat/AI/cast/MP/spell-menu code via a single multiply-by-stride accessor.
logic_summary: 252 bytes = 36 entries x 7-byte struct spell_effect (pack(1), little-endian). Accessed exclusively through accessor fd2_get_spell_effect_entry @ 0x4E516 whose body is 'return base + spell_id*7' (= &table[spell_id]); the table address has exactly one DATA xref, from that accessor at 0x4E523. Callers read fields off the returned pointer at their struct byte offsets: +0 damage as *(short*) signed16 (fd2_calc_magic_damage 0x1C75E base_power, fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target 0x1C8ED), +2 hit_rate as *(byte*) (fd2_calc_magic_damage chance_pct), +5 mp_cost as *(byte*) (fd2_deduct_caster_mp 0x1CA89, fd2_draw_spell_selection_list 0x1CEED). 11 caller functions total reach the table via the accessor (combat/AI/cast/MP-deduct/spell-menu sub-paths). No writer exists anywhere -> const.
datatype: spell_effect[36]  (struct spell_effect, 7-byte pack(1) stride; 252 bytes total)
element_semantics: struct spell_effect per entry: +0 damage (uint16, max damage or heal power, read signed by damage formula), +2 hit_rate (uint8, percent), +3 cast_range_flags (uint8: bit4=line attack, low4=distance), +4 area (uint8, AoE radius, max 3), +5 mp_cost (uint8), +6 target_side (uint8: 0=enemy, 1=self). Field order matches struct spell_effect in src/include/types.h. Entry index = spell id 0x00..0x23.
comment_original_issue: Source comment block (btltab3.c lines 602-621) was already accurate and precise, with one minor numeric inaccuracy: it stated 'The 10 caller functions' but Ghidra get_function_callers(fd2_get_spell_effect_entry) returns 11 distinct caller functions. Corrected 10 -> 11.

issues.title: Ghidra struct type name 'spell_entry' differs from src struct name 'spell_effect'
issues.description: The Ghidra data type applied at 0x619FD is 'spell_entry[36]' (label data_fd2_battle_spell_effect_table, length 252), while src/include/types.h and btltab3.c use the struct name 'spell_effect'. The two structs are byte-identical (7-byte pack(1), same field order/widths), so this is a cosmetic naming divergence only -- no layout or value difference. Not changed in this stage (type renames are out of scope for src-refine). Recorded for later type-name harmonization if desired.
issues.evidence: Ghidra getDataAt(0x619fd): DT=spell_entry[36], DLEN=252, LABEL=data_fd2_battle_spell_effect_table. src/include/types.h line 80-87 defines 'typedef struct {...} spell_effect;'. btltab3.c line 622: 'const spell_effect data_fd2_battle_spell_effect_table[36]'.

notes: Field semantics verified live: fd2_calc_magic_damage reads base_power=*(ushort*)pSpell then casts (short); chance_pct=*(byte*)(pSpell+2). fd2_deduct_caster_mp subtracts *(byte*)(entry+5). Byte values in src verified byte-exact against read_memory(0x619fd): entry0 32 00 5A 05 00 02 00 -> {damage=50, hit=90, range_flags=5, area=0, mp=2, side=0} matches src row 0x00 '{50,90,5,0,2,0}'; entry 0x09 raw 0xE7 0x03 = 999 matches '{999,...}'. const confirmed by zero write-xrefs (only DATA xref is the accessor read). Ghidra data plate (PLATE_COMMENT) was blank (null) while a detailed but convention-wrong PRE_COMMENT carried the docs; created a concise PLATE_COMMENT (project convention: data plate must live in PLATE_COMMENT) reflecting the src conclusion, left the existing PRE_COMMENT intact. FD2.LE saved. run_script_inline initially appeared flaky but the real cause was a compile error (CodeUnit has no getDataType(); use Listing.getDataAt); fixed and it works.
